EasyUse Anima 0.5.6 keeps newer queue edits intact and stabilizes AiO seed modes.

Changes:
1. Older or out-of-order results no longer overwrite newer LoRA Preset and Prompt Studio edits.
2. Prompt Studio Wildcard updates its next seed only when the queued result still matches the current edit.
3. AiO Random Each, Increment Each, and Decrement Each keep -1, -2, and -3 in the editable seed field while recording the concrete execution seed separately.
4. AiO concrete seeds update to their next value only when no newer edit exists.
5. Use Last and New Fixed Random switch both the seed and its control to one concrete fixed value.
6. Returning to a concrete AiO seed after a special seed stream now uses the explicitly entered value.
7. Existing workflows, settings, profiles, node sockets, and saved special seed selections remain compatible.

Action required:
After updating, restart ComfyUI and hard-refresh the browser.
